title: OpenAI details a coordinated attempt to extract hidden model reasoning
friendlyTitle: OpenAI says attackers tried to copy hidden model reasoning
summary: OpenAI says it disrupted a coordinated adversarial-distillation campaign involving extraction patterns across more than 15,000 users, attributing a core cluster to people associated with Moonshot AI. The company says attackers manipulated model interactions rather than breaching databases or stored conversations.
friendlySummary: OpenAI found a large campaign that tried to make its models reveal protected reasoning. It says no database or stored user chats were broken into.
whyItMatters: Model security now includes protecting generated reasoning artifacts across accounts, tools and cloud partners. Organisations building agent systems should treat replayable outputs, conversation compaction and third-party hosting as parts of the same threat model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI security is not only about passwords and databases. Teams must also protect model outputs when they move between users, tools and cloud services.
